# XrealAndroidBridge

**Inherits:** [`Object`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_object.html)  
**Script:** `addons/godot_xreal/xreal_android_bridge.gd`  

Bootstrap for the XrealBridge Java helper (addons/godot_xreal/android/src/…/XrealBridge.java): registers the bridge on the activity, moves the companion window onto the XREAL display when needed, and enables auto-enter Picture-in-Picture so the glasses keep rendering while the app is backgrounded on the phone (multi-resume). Call register() once at startup (see demo/main.gd). The Java methods are idempotent; this is the Godot-side fallback for template drift.
